title: MDX Player for CardputerZero
summary: Play Sharp X68000 MDX music with live FM and PCM meters.
description: Play Sharp X68000 MDX music with the RetroFM playback core from the FM-1 MDX player. The app supports PDX sample banks, a note spectrum, and individual FM and PCM meters. Browse folders, save favorites, and choose repeat or continuous playback. Auto follows the active audio output, mixing to mono for the built-in speaker and using stereo for wired headphones and stereo Bluetooth outputs. Press M to select Auto, Mono, or Stereo. Copy your MDX files and any matching PDX banks to Music/MDX Library in your home folder.
